script: n=$(nproc); m=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max 2>/dev/null || echo none); echo "nproc=$n memory.max=$m cpu.max=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max 2>/dev/null || echo none)" >&2; test "$n" -eq 2 && test "$m" = 4294967296
